name: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Ltd
title: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Ltd - 533023 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 CV brake-systems maker grew sales 9.3% with CV>6T volumes +8.6% and aftermarket +15.6%, but reported PAT fell 14.7% on a prior-year FX gain; margins squeezed by aluminium and pass-through lags.

triggers.label: Aluminium INR 260→360/kg
triggers.quote: aluminum has gone higher close to INR 100 from around INR 260 per kg, and it has gone up to more than INR 360 per kg.
triggers.highlight: aluminum has gone higher close to INR 100

triggers.label: Selective aftermarket price hikes July 2026
triggers.quote: implemented selective price increases effective July 2026.
triggers.highlight: implemented selective price increases effective July 2026

triggers.label: July OEM production ~10k above typical
triggers.quote: we see the July month itself, we are seeing an average of 40,000 to 42,000 vehicle production, which is almost 10,000 higher than typical July.

triggers.label: ESC wins from three major OEMs
triggers.quote: Having secured business nominations from three major OEMs and progressing discussions with other key customers
triggers.highlight: business nominations from three major OEMs

guidance.value: around 7.5% growth, expected to remain at this level
guidance.quote: we have seen around 7.5% growth, last quarter versus this quarter. I think we see that it should remain at this level

red_flags.label: Reported PAT down 14.7% on FX gain base
Commodity pass-through lag ~2 quarters
red_flags.quote: Typically, this happens over a 2 quarter lag, but owing to this conflict, it has taken a little longer than usual.

evasions.quote: At this moment, we are not able to predict because there are a lot of geopolitical uncertainties around it.
So AEBS is something that we'll have to still wait and see how

summary.headline: ZF CV India Q1 FY27: Total income up 5.7% to ₹1,101.8 cr; PAT fell 14.7% to ₹104.5 cr on a high base FX gain, while aftermarket rose 15.6% to ₹158.4 cr.
